interface_contract: sanitize_or_denial(role, request, response, independently reviewed source index) returns only bounded verified advisory display references with reviewed exact npm package semver intervals and original upstream URLs. Unknown or malformed data fail closed. User-submitted local responses must never be misrepresented as independently captured originals. No raw third-party response bodies are republished.
local_external_input_policy: Caller-supplied source role limited to two direct modes or routed mode. Exact precommitted target + public version-review source; no dynamic advisory or package claims. Positive only DISPLAY_ONLY, not accept package as safe. Missing or unknown advisory reference DENY.
benchmark_policy: 3 genuine external original records, 12 synthetic tampering attempts; never call all 15 real external observations. A naive paid-status policy admits all three originals and all six/each direct advisory refs. A target-only policy admits two direct outputs including two independently version-inapplicable references; the combined gate admits two sanitized outputs with exactly five reviewed version-applicable references per output.
success_definition: The actual original three Git blob verified captures + six Git blob reviewed advisory files show routed unscoped 100 row feed denied, 2 direct original provider responses allowed to display exactly 5 refs each, one proven inapplicable per direct source omitted and all injected/unverified records rejected; reusable user-provided local JSON contract exercised with no network or safety approval claims.
